name: Korinek et al. 2026, modest-change scenario
description: Swaps korinek-2026.json from the substantial scenario to the MODEST one: "AI acts like a normal technology - roughly the impact of the internet by 2030". Replaces the exogenous adoption curve (end point 0.023 instead of 0.118) and the two scenario-specific parameters (psi 0.1, re-employment 6 months). No equation of the base model is touched, because the scenario difference genuinely is only its inputs and two coefficients. Its own tests assert the paper's published modest-scenario US 2030 outputs at the tolerances validation/korinekTests.ts uses.

source.label: Korinek et al. 2026 reproduction, reduced form; see constants.ts KORINEK_SCENARIOS (modest: psi = 0.1)
source.note: Fraction of AI-affected cognitive tasks automated rather than augmented, chosen per scenario so the displaced pool lands on the published cognitive-unemployment number.

source.label: Korinek et al. 2026 reproduction, reduced form; see constants.ts KORINEK_SCENARIOS (modest: 6 months)
source.note: This repo's own displaced-pool residence time, not the paper's search discount mu.

source.label: Scenario input: share of US cognitive tasks performed by AI by end-2030 (0.023) (their m x d), ramped from 1% in mid-2026 along the logistic path in validation/korinek.ts::adoptionPath
source.note: Korinek et al. treat the capability/adoption path as an exogenous input and derive outcomes from it; this model does the same. The 2030 end point (0.118 substantial, 0.023 modest, 0.45 extreme) is from the paper's scenarios; the logistic shape between mid-2026 and end-2030 is this repo's own smoothing assumption, not the paper's.
